label: Respect of what is understood: Understood: Respect: the respect in which an intellect is otherwise…
definition: `understood : Respect`: the respect in which an intellect is otherwise when it passes from one object of understanding to another (transire de uno intellecto in aliud, In Metaph. XII, lect. 11 n. 8). A Lean parameter of FirstMoverCannotChangeWhatItUnderstandsReading. It is not one of the respects of change of DEF-RESPECT-OF-CHANGE (substance, quantity, quality, place); Aquinas calls passing in it 'quidam motus', a kind of motion in a wider sense, which the case's broad MovedIn (DISAMB-MOTION) covers. The Lean declaration is the reading of which `understood` is a parameter; the type does not encode that `understood` is not a respect of change (it has no OfChange parameter), so that is a gloss of the reading.
